norms.integral_rel: |int u+ dy - int u+_DNS dy| / int u+_DNS dy (mass flux)
norms.mean_rel_weighted: sum(V e)/sum(V), signed bias under the same measure
norms.rms_rel_unweighted: sqrt(mean(e^2)), one vote per cell centre (implemented legacy metric)
norms.rms_rel_weighted: sqrt(sum(V e^2)/sum(V)), wall-normal volume weighted (declared metric of the DNS provenance)

windows.legacy_full: y+ in [30, centreline]; literal anchor wording
windows.log_layer: y+ in [30, 0.2 Re_tau]; the only interval that is logarithmic at this Re_tau
